name: Villa Gallici
positioning: 18th-century Provencal residence with baroque decor and a garden pool, a short walk from the centre of Aix-en-Provence
best_for: Couples who want a romantic, garden-set hideaway within walking distance of Aix-en-Provence
Travelers who love period decor and Louis XV furnishings

facts.text: Villa Gallici is set in an elegant 18th-century residence.
The Provencal residence has refined baroque decoration.
The setting blends the Provencal art of living with Italian dolce vita.
The hotel is a few minutes' walk from the centre of Aix-en-Provence.
The hotel is a 15-minute walk to Cours Mirabeau, yet has a quiet, countryside seclusion.
The house is surrounded by lavender and cypress trees.
The outdoor swimming pool is heated.
The spa has two treatment rooms, a sauna, a Jacuzzi, cryotherapy and fitness.
The hotel has an on-site wine cellar.
Rooms have a hushed boudoir atmosphere, comfortable wing chairs and an interior design inspired by a French way of life, with elegant touches of exoticism.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites have either a private garden or views of the grounds, and are furnished in toile, cream and crimson Louis XV pieces.
The house opens onto a garden filled with the fragrances of Provence, with cypress trees sheltering the outdoor swimming pool.
Room choices range from the classic room to a private villa set in the French-style gardens.
Rooms have majestic beds and Louis XV writing desks.
La Taula Gallici, the gourmet restaurant, serves seasonal cuisine inspired by Provence and Italy by Chef Christophe Gavot, in the shade of plane trees.

considerations.text: Parking is available at a supplement.
La Dolce Serata, the Italian restaurant, is open only from June to September.
WhataHotel notes a small boutique size with fewer facilities than larger hotels.
